automations.name: conductor implementer
automations.trigger: work-classified prompt decomposed into items with fileScope/testScope
tools_mcp: opencode tools gated by conductor plugin
automations.stop_rule: item FSM PENDING->RED->TEST_VETTED->GREEN->VALIDATED->REVIEWED->PUBLISHED; handler re-derives evidence, model claim never advances state
automations.instructions_summary: Implement within declared fileScope minus testScope; behavioral items cannot reach GREEN without an observed vetted RED first
automations.instructions_excerpt: A model saying tests pass advances nothing (README: handler-derived evidence).

automations.name: conductor test-writer
tools_mcp: opencode tools gated by conductor plugin
automations.stop_rule: test vetted before implementation may proceed (TEST_VETTED)
automations.instructions_summary: Write the failing test first; vetting precedes GREEN

automations.name: conductor adversarial reviewers
automations.trigger: plan review and item REVIEWED stage
automations.stop_rule: findings face refuters before they count; surviving majors force revision and re-review
automations.instructions_summary: Fresh sub-sessions with no memory of writing the code review the work

automations.name: conductor verify/freshness gates
automations.trigger: every verify and every edit during a verify
automations.stop_rule: verify start-stamped against HEAD; an edit to a staged behavioral file or a moved HEAD voids it; verify freeze blocks edits during verification
automations.instructions_summary: Evidence freshness enforced mechanically; doctrine packs re-injected on every request

setup_declared.notes: Declared from repository documentation only (README, docs/, conductor/docs/HONEST-LIMITS.md), commit 'main' as of 2026-08-30. Controls live in the conductor opencode plugin (TypeScript gate stack), not in .cursor/.github conventions, so framework inspect cannot mechanically detect them - the 12 inspect gaps are convention mismatches, not absent controls. hooks=true refers to conductor's FSM gates and verify freeze, not .cursor/hooks.json. ci_gate=true refers to enforced visible test suites plus hidden-test benchmark gauge. No human PR review loop exists; this is a single-operator local harness.
